messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Good, Data Saver mode is now off. Now let's check your current internet speed to see where we stand.

Please use **run_speed_test** on your phone to measure your current internet connection speed.

Let me know what result you get (it should tell you if the speed is unknown, very poor, poor, fair, good, or excellent).

I tried running the speed test, but it failed because there is no connection. The mobile data is turned on and shows an excellent signal, but I am still unable to get any connection for the speed test. What should I try next?

Please process the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
